newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Red Electrica to pay 25 bln pta dividends.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Red Electrica to pay 25 bln pta dividends.

text.p: Spain's Red Electrica Espanola, the electrical network controlled by energy group Endesa, said on Monday it had agreed to distribute a total extraordinary dividend against reserves of 22 billion pesetas to be paid on June 30.

At an extraordinary shareholders meeting, Red Electrica said it had also agreed to distribute an interim dividend of three billion pesetas on 1997 profits which would be paid on September 30, a statement said.

Furthermore, the electrical network said it had signed an agreement with Netcorp, the consortium comprising Endesa, Union Fenosa and Italian telecommunications firm Stet, to allow it to use a part of Red Electrica's fibre optic network for 30 years.
